source_temperature_definitions: Table II labels Tonset, Tmax1 and Tmax2. Discussion describes Tonset as where decomposition begins, without a stated tangent or mass-loss criterion. Tmax1/2 lack an explicit maximum-rate or DTG definition; all three temperature columns remain source-native.
limitations: Numerical values come from the original indexed Tables II–III; PDF bytes and figure pixels were unavailable, so no pixel-level consistency claim is made. TG aliquot mass, handling, pan and replication and LOI standard, dimensions, replication and uncertainty are unreported. Fabric yarn-density units and incomplete sol-mixing quantities are preserved without correction. Source state E is excluded because preparation assigns SiO2–DOPO, whereas Figure 5 labels it DOPO–KH570. The discussion gives a general LOI increase range of 1.6–3.0 percentage points, inconsistent with the larger differences in Table III; the individual tabulated LOIs are retained, with F = 22.8 also repeated in the abstract and conclusion. Reported mass gains are grams, not percentage add-ons. No durability-washed pair is established.
sample_state: C: SiO2–KH570 finished plain woven cotton fabric
composition: 100% plain woven cotton; SiO2–KH570 finish, retained percentage add-on unreported
treatment_method: The 100% plain woven cotton from Nanjing Qicaimei Textile Company was boiled in water for at least 0.5 h, washed in 2.0% non-ionic detergent at 40 °C for 20 min, rinsed several times with deionized water and blast-dried until the remaining mass change was below 1.0%. The cleaned fabric was conditioned at 20 ± 2 °C and 65 ± 4% relative humidity for at least 24 h before experiments. The stated warp/weft densities are 133.0/72.0 yarns/cm; these source units are retained without correction. KH570, anhydrous ethanol and deionized water were mixed at volume ratio 20.0:72.0:8.0 and hydrolyzed with magnetic stirring at room temperature. The source names this mixture C, SiO2–KH570 composite sol, although this sentence does not describe a separate addition of the TEOS sol. The resulting hybrid sols were aged for 2 h before use. A small, unquantified amount of penetrant JFC-1 was added; cut fabric was immersed in the corresponding bath at room temperature for 2 h and cured in a PHG-9036A oven at 100 °C for 5 min. No post-treatment rinse or durability wash is stated.
washing_state: Initial finished fabric after 100 °C curing; no durability wash assigned
pairing_evidence: Section II.C explicitly maps sample C to this prepared cotton fabric. Tables II and III use the same sample letter for char residue 41.40% and measured LOI 22.2%; both assays concern the fabric before any durability washing.
